items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip issue; returns from multi-week absence.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report; Schefter notes expected to play; McVay positive.
items.implication: WR1 back in lineup vs PHI; monitor possible snap limits.
items.opportunity: Primary target share return with Adams.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; returns from hamstring after missing games.
items.why: ETR report; Rapoport confirms good to go; Texans PR active.
items.implication: Elite WR1 spot vs DAL (worst DvP).
items.opportunity: High target share in elevated scoring environment.

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams due to hamstring.
items.why: Official ruling via Schefter; ETR lists with Goedert.
items.implication: Eagles pass game severely depleted vs LAR.
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining WRs/TEs; overall offense downgrade.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Sunday with sprained ankle.
items.why: Schefter report; ETR confirms OUT; no practice progress.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison primary beneficiary home vs soft secondary.

items.text: Breece Hall ruled OUT (quad) along with Adonai Mitchell vs Bears.
items.why: Jets official via Schefter; ETR confirms.
items.implication: Full RB snaps to backup; Wilson target boost without Mitchell.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup elevation; Garrett Wilson higher target share.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation on possible snap limits, we'll see.
items.why: Return from absence; eye on workload management.
items.implication: Start but beware limited snaps early.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if full; else Adams/Kupp heavier.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.opportunity: High target volume vs vulnerable secondary.

items.text: Moment Jordan Addison truthers waiting for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: JJ absence creates clear target opportunity.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes in favorable matchup.

items.text: De'Von Achane listed OUT; Caleb Douglas also out.
items.implication: MIA backfield shift; reduced explosive plays.
items.opportunity: Backup RB and remaining pass-catchers elevated.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Zach Charbonnet also listed.
items.why: ETR; Schefter confirms; Levitan details role erosion prior.
items.implication: SEA RB committee further thinned short-term.
items.opportunity: Other SEA backs elevated for week.

items.text: Dallas Goedert among players OUT Sunday (with Smith, Baun).
items.why: Schefter out list; ETR confirms; Levitan notes Eagles worse without three key pieces.
items.implication: PHI TE vacuum and overall skill-position depletion vs LAR.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out again; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; top-10 play.
items.why: Full workhorse with Dowdle OUT; strong matchup.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet practicing. Still passes eye test long-term.
items.why: Multiple role losses + injury + competition return.
items.implication: Short-term fade; long-term hold for talent.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%, 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Low usage profile meets elite run defense.
